en-US.name: Diwali Family Game Night
en-US.shortDescription: Pass one iPhone or iPad around: 2 or more players
en-US.longDescription: Light the diyas and gather the family. Look at the pegs, roll a color, find it. Most pegs wins. No ads, plays offline.

en-GB.name: Diwali Family Games Night
en-GB.shortDescription: Pass one iPhone or iPad round: 2 or more players
en-GB.longDescription: Light the diyas and gather the family. Look at the pegs, roll a colour, find it. Most pegs wins. No ads, plays offline.

hi.name: दिवाली फ़ैमिली गेम नाइट
hi.shortDescription: एक iPhone या iPad, 2 या ज़्यादा खिलाड़ी
hi.longDescription: दीये जलाओ, सबको बुलाओ। गोटियाँ देखो, पासा फेंको, रंग ढूँढो। सबसे ज़्यादा गोटियों वाला जीतेगा। विज्ञापन नहीं, ऑफ़लाइन।

fr-FR.name: Jeux en famille pour Diwali
fr-FR.shortDescription: À 2 ou plus, sur un seul iPhone ou iPad
fr-FR.longDescription: Allume les diyas. Regarde les pions, lance le dé et trouve la couleur. Qui en a le plus gagne. Sans pub, hors ligne.

de-DE.name: Diwali-Familienspieleabend
de-DE.shortDescription: Ab 2 Personen an einem iPhone oder iPad
de-DE.longDescription: Zünde die Diyas an! Merk dir die Spielsteine, würfle, finde die Farbe. Wer die meisten hat, gewinnt. Werbefrei, offline.

es-MX.name: Juegos en familia para Diwali
es-MX.shortDescription: 2 o más jugadores en un solo iPhone o iPad
es-MX.longDescription: Enciende diyas en familia. Mira las fichas, lanza el dado y busca. ¡Gana quien tenga más! Sin anuncios, sin conexión.

pt-BR.name: Jogos em família no Diwali
pt-BR.shortDescription: 2 ou mais jogadores no mesmo iPhone ou iPad
pt-BR.longDescription: Acenda diyas em família. Olhe os pinos, role o dado, ache a cor. Quem pegar mais vence! Sem anúncios, funciona offline.

notes: Times are UTC: the event runs Nov 1 00:00 to Nov 13 00:00 India time (IST = UTC+5:30); Diwali is Nov 8 2026.
publishStart is 9 days before the start (Apple allows up to 14). Submit by Oct 18 (2 weeks before the start), right after 1.2.1 is approved, so review (about 1 day) finishes before publishStart.
Copy says '2 or more players', true on 1.2.0 (2 Players free, 3 Players paid) and on 1.2.1 (2 to 4). No prices, no purchase needed for the event, so purchaseRequirement stays empty.

No deepLink: app/game.tsx exists (pegrecall://game?mode=2p would open a 2-player game), but it skips Home's 'Who's playing?' sheet and is untested on a device. Without a deep link the event opens the app on Home, where 2/3/4 Players are.
Media has no text (Apple: avoid text and logos in event media). Same two images for every locale.
